title: Jentic Operation
description: Represents an API operation or workflow in the Jentic catalog, including its metadata, input schema, and execution requirements.

uuid.description: Unique identifier for the operation, prefixed with 'op_' for operations or 'wf_' for workflows.

name.description: Human-readable name of the operation or workflow.

description.description: Detailed description of what the operation or workflow does.

type.description: Whether this is a single API operation or a multi-step Arazzo workflow.

api_name.description: Name of the upstream API that provides this operation.

method.description: HTTP method for the operation, applicable to single operations.

path.description: URL path template for the operation.

inputs.description: JSON Schema describing the required and optional input parameters.

auth_required.description: Whether upstream API credentials must be configured in the Jentic credential vault.

InputSchema.description: Schema describing the input parameters for an operation.

required.description: List of required input parameter names.

properties.description: Map of parameter names to their type definitions.

InputParameter.description: Definition of a single input parameter for an operation.

type.description: The data type of the parameter.

default.description: Default value for the parameter when not provided.

format.description: Format hint for the parameter value, such as 'email', 'uri', or 'date-time'.
